newsitem.title: USA: Magicworks acquires Space Agency Inc.
newsitem.headline: Magicworks acquires Space Agency Inc.

text.p: Magicworks Entertainment Inc said on Monday it acquired Space Agency Inc in a a stock for stock acquisition.

Space Agency Inc, which operates under the name Space Agency Concerts & Theatricals and is based in Salt Lake City, is an independent presenter of live entertainment in North America with revenues of $25 million in 1996. Space Agency becomes a wholly-owned subsidiary of Magicworks.
Magicworks Entertainment, headquartered on Miami Beach, acquires domestic and international stage and ancillary rights to theatrical productions.
In the first nine months of 1996, Magicworks revenues exceeded $38 million. The combined revenues of the two newly merged companies in 1996 will exceed $70 million.
